risks.risk: TV may not be working at all (screen appears black; could be power/board failure beyond transformer).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the TV powered on showing a channel/menu screen (and volume OSD) plus a close-up of the screen for lines/dead pixels.

risks.risk: Transformer claim may be wrong; other boards (main board/T-con/backlight driver) could be damaged, raising repair cost.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV back cover opened (showing the transformer and any burnt components) OR a receipt/diagnostic note from a technician stating the exact failed part.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst case repair uncertainty (as not working).

risks.risk: Screen condition cannot be verified (dead pixels/lines).
risks.proof: Screen test photos/videos: full-screen solid colors (red/green/blue/white/black) and a grid pattern, taken while powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible display issues (worst case).

risks.risk: Remote may be missing or incompatible.
risks.proof: Photo of the remote next to the TV model/label, or a video showing the remote controlling the TV menu.

risks.risk: Exact model/series and panel type not confirmed; affects parts availability and value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the TV label/sticker on the back showing model number (e.g., LG model code).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/unknown LG 29-inch with uncertain specs.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the TV back label/sticker showing the exact LG model number.
Send a short video of the TV powered on (menu/channel screen visible) and show the screen for lines/dead pixels.
If the transformer is the issue: send a photo of the opened back showing the transformer and any burnt marks, or a technician diagnostic/receipt stating the failed part.
Send a photo of the remote (and ideally a quick clip showing it works).
response.reason: From photo 0, the TV screen is not clearly shown as working and key identity details (LG model/size) and the remote are not verifiable, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without proof.
